name: explainer-video
description: Narrated explainer and guide videos of a web app: Playwright drives the real UI with a visible cursor; a spotlight and a camera that zooms mark what each line names, on the word that names it; chapters, a cover card, preview and recap cards, and flowchart, terminal and code scenes explain what the UI cannot; a voice reads the script, Kokoro 82M (af_heart) on this machine or ElevenLabs when the user chooses a more human read. Recorded at 1920x1080 in slow motion for smooth motion and built into a web-sized H.264 MP4 with chapters, captions, a transcript, a poster and an embed page, with the producer’s credit on the cover and closing cards. A review sheet puts every line beside the stills taken as its words are spoken; a dry run also gives a written guide, a click-through walkthrough and an A4 PDF guide. The skill says which effects suit which video, and includes the voice setup check and installer, the tour kit, voicing, build, verify and review scripts, templates, and the traps behind each rule.
